name: calm-desk
description: A consent-first guided breathing session driven by live camera vitals from the Presage SmartSpectra SDK.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x900x24" electron scripts/smoke.cjs --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --simulate --session-seconds=30
scripts.smoke:real: npm run build && SMARTSPECTRA_API_KEY=dummy-key-for-smoke-test xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x900x24" electron scripts/smoke-real.cjs --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --use-fake-device-for-media-stream
